chunk_findings.detail: The suppression names the wrong rule. `__all__ = sorted(...)` is a call, not a list or tuple, so pylint/ruff emit PLE0604 (`invalid-all-object`: `__all__` must be a list or tuple). PLE0605 (`invalid-all-format`) only fires when a list/tuple element is not a string. `# noqa: PLE0605` therefore does not silence the diagnostic this comment claims to waive: `ruff check ddflow/config/__init__.py` still fails on this line with PLE0604. A working suppression would be `# noqa: PLE0604` (or an assignment ruff can see as a list/tuple of strings).
